If I add a chord between vertices at odd distance (like distance 7), both resulting cycles have even length, preserving bipartiteness. So a chord from vertex 0 to vertex 7 creates cycles of length 8 and 14, giving me girth 8, which works. That's 21 edges total, still 2-colorable, and the only cycles are those two, so the girth is exactly 8.
